interpretation: Primary accommodation signal = reachable_fraction_3p5A: poses with an HMDA amine-N within 3.5 A of the acyl carbonyl-C (distance only). near_attack_fraction adds a Burgi-Dunitz angle gate [90,120] deg, which is stricter and fragile on static cofold poses. Both are steric feasibility for the C6 diamine, not catalytic rate; step-2 geometry did not rank activity on the experimental panel (step-1 did). Output lacks hydrogens, so the closest amine-N is used (neutral vs protonated amine not distinguishable geometrically).
